description: Time series of a single financial metric for one A-share across reporting periods. `metric` is an indicators-table field name (roe_simple / revenue / ni_parent / debt_asset_ratio / gross_margin / eps_basic, ~150 supported).

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

metric.description: Indicator field name (e.g. roe_simple, revenue, ni_parent)

name: financials_series
